answer: A VDF-bound identity ticket turns Sybil farming into a slow grind. A new agent must solve a verifiable delay function taking 10 minutes of single-core CPU to register, and the ticket binds to one hardware key, so one machine mints at most 144 identities a day. Faking 10,000 agents then needs 70 machines running nonstop for a day, about $14,000 in hardware plus $210 in electricity, just to start. Each ticket is nectar in a guarded hive, sweet to earn and worthless to steal, and an onyx-black fake is easy to spot since its ticket never matches the atlas of registered keys.
